user.title: RoomMind
user.description: Set up RoomMind to manage room climate. Rooms are configured in the RoomMind panel after setup.

confirm_restart.title: Restart Home Assistant?
confirm_restart.description: RoomMind {version} has been installed but Home Assistant is still running an older version. Restart to complete the update.

sensor_stale.title: {room}: temperature sensor is not updating
sensor_stale.description: RoomMind cannot receive a current room temperature. Check that the configured sensor is available and reporting updates.

long_run.title: {room}: climate device has been running for a long time
long_run.description: Check the room temperature, open windows, and the device configuration. The configured run-time threshold has been exceeded.

target_not_reached.title: {room}: target temperature is not being reached
target_not_reached.description: Check the temperature sensor, device availability, and whether the room has enough heating or cooling capacity.

humidity_high.title: {room}: humidity is well above the comfort target
humidity_high.description: Check ventilation, the humidity sensor, and whether a dehumidification device is available.

ac_efficiency.title: {room}: air conditioner may be underperforming
ac_efficiency.description: RoomMind observed low temperature response for the measured power. Check filters, outdoor conditions, and the device.
